steps.details: Retro-check C†: `Get-Disk | Select Number, FriendlyName, Size, PartitionStyle, OperationalStatus` — shows two array disks, system volume holds C:. [Uncertain] how RAIDXpert2 arrays are named/numbered in `Get-Disk`.

steps.title: No array shows Offline; if one does, delete and recreate
steps.details: Same retro-check: `OperationalStatus`

steps.title: Load driver: rcbottom → rcraid → rccfg
Disk list shows the arrays, not member disks
Shift+F10 → `diskpart` → `clean` system volume and RAID0
steps.details: Guidance only (AGENTS.md rule 7)

steps.title: Install to unallocated space on the system volume; leave RAID0 untouched
First reboot: "Windows Boot Manager" in the boot menu (F12 on Lenovo)
steps.details: Retro-check C: `bcdedit /enum firmware` (checklist command). C†: which disk holds the FAT32 ESP: `Get-Partition | Where GptType -eq '{c12a7328-f81f-11d2-ba4b-00a0c93ec93b}'`

steps.title: If the boot entry is missing: `bcdboot W:\Windows /s S: /f UEFI`, `bcdedit /enum firmware`
steps.details: Shown as recovery text, never executed

steps.title: Log in with the show (auto-logon) account
steps.details: C: W-00.3 identity check; records the show account SID (later checks)

steps.title: Elevated PowerShell: `.\WO7-Setup.ps1 -Phase PreUpdate` (preceded by `-Audit`, S4)
steps.details: Engine: WO7-Setup.ps1 -Phase PreUpdate (no other parameters). Pre-check C†: no physical adapter `Up` (`Get-NetAdapter -Physical`). Post-check C†: `SearchOrderConfig = 0` (`HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\DriverSearching`), policies `ExcludeWUDriversInQualityUpdate = 1`, `DontPromptForWindowsUpdate = 1` read back.

steps.title: Reboot (cable still unplugged)
steps.details: Checklist line added Oct 2026 (the script's "Reboot now" is right, OQ 12). Pre-check C†: still no physical adapter `Up`.

steps.title: Install NIC driver from USB
steps.details: Checklist command: `pnputil /add-driver <path>\*.inf /subdirs /install` (operator picks `<path>`). Exit code `3010` = success, reboot required → offer reboot.

steps.title: Adapter in Device Manager without warning icon
steps.details: Open `devmgmt.msc`. C†: `Get-PnpDevice -Class Net -PresentOnly | Select FriendlyName, Status, Problem` → physical NIC `Status = OK`

steps.title: Plug in the network cable
steps.details: C†: adapter `Status = Up`

steps.title: Windows Update: install everything, reboot, repeat until nothing is left
steps.details: Open `ms-settings:windowsupdate`. C†: pending-reboot probe (ARCHITECTURE §7.3). The step loops: "Reboot and come back" / "Nothing left — done".

steps.title: RAID: three AMD drivers present
steps.details: `pnputil /enum-drivers | findstr /i /c:"rcbottom" /c:"rcraid" /c:"rccfg"` → all three found. Not applicable if no AMD RAID (operator confirms). PROJECT_CONTEXT: `rccfg` may not be carried over from Setup [Uncertain] — this check is how you find out.

steps.title: Install AMD RAID package with RAIDXpert2 (same driver version as loaded in Setup)
steps.details: C†: show `rcraid` driver version from `Get-WindowsDriver -Online` before/after for comparison (display only)

steps.title: Chipset and storage drivers
steps.details: C† pending-reboot probe

steps.title: NVIDIA driver at the version tested for your WATCHOUT release
steps.details: C†: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv,noheader` (or `Win32_VideoController.DriverVersion`) compared with the version captured in WO7-01.4

steps.title: Capture and audio drivers; test each in the vendor's app
`manage-bde -status C:` → if not "Fully Decrypted" …
steps.details: Shows `manage-bde -status C:`; evaluates `Get-BitLockerVolume -MountPoint C:` (`VolumeStatus = FullyDecrypted`) so it works on a localised Windows

steps.title: … run `manage-bde -off C:` and wait
steps.details: Checklist command `manage-bde -off C:`; progress polled from `EncryptionPercentage` until FullyDecrypted. Shown only if 05.1 fails.

steps.title: Disk Management: initialise RAID0 as GPT, format NTFS (64 KB optional)
steps.details: Open `diskmgmt.msc`. Never automated (AGENTS.md rule 7). C†: `Get-Disk` (`PartitionStyle = GPT`) + `Get-Volume` (`FileSystem = NTFS`, `AllocationUnitSize`) for the RAID0

steps.title: Turn off indexing on the RAID0 drive
steps.details: C†: `Get-CimInstance Win32_Volume | Select DriveLetter, IndexingEnabled` → `False` for the RAID0

steps.title: RAIDXpert2: array healthy; write-back cache / read-ahead optional

Tweaks: Activity History, ConsumerFeatures, Delivery Optimization, Explorer folder discovery, Hibernation, Location, Store search results, Services to Manual, Telemetry, Temp files, Widgets, WPBT, Home and Gallery, OneDrive removal, System Tray notifications, Windows AI

steps.title: Also tick: BitLocker - Disable, Visual Effects - Best Performance, Storage Sense - Disable

Preferences: BSoD Verbose on, Lock Screen - Disable on, Sticky Keys off, Game Mode off
Do NOT click either Ultimate Performance button
Multiplane Overlay: leave Enabled; disable only if soak test shows flicker/blackouts

Confirm Power Management Mode = Prefer Maximum Performance, Vertical Sync = Off

sections.title: Windows settings from the Dataton guide

steps.title: UAC → Never notify (10.8)
steps.details: Open `UserAccountControlSettings.exe`. C†: `HKLM\…\Policies\System` `ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin = 0`, `PromptOnSecureDesktop = 0` (the values the WO6 script uses for "Never notify")

steps.title: Visual effects → Adjust for best performance (10.3; skip if ticked in WinUtil)
steps.details: Open `SystemPropertiesPerformance.exe`. C†: `HKCU\…\Explorer\VisualEffects` `VisualFXSetting = 2`

steps.title: Remote Assistance off (10.4)
steps.details: Open `SystemPropertiesRemote.exe`. C†: `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Remote Assistance` `fAllowToGetHelp = 0`

steps.title: Sounds → "No Sounds" (10.7)
steps.details: Open `mmsys.cpl`. C†: `HKCU\AppEvents\Schemes` default = `.None`

steps.title: `dfrgui` → untick "Run on a schedule" (10.9)
steps.details: Open `dfrgui`. C†: `Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\Microsoft\Windows\Defrag\' -TaskName ScheduledDefrag` → `Disabled`

steps.title: USB: connection and USB-issue notifications off (10.12)
steps.details: Open `ms-settings:usb`. C†: `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Shell\USB` `NotifyOnUsbErrors = 0` [Uncertain value name]

steps.title: Taskbar: show badges off (10.13)
steps.details: Open `ms-settings:taskbar`. C†: `HKCU\…\Explorer\Advanced` `TaskbarBadges = 0`

steps.title: Startup apps: off for everything not needed (10.14)
steps.details: Open `ms-settings:startupapps`

steps.title: Indexing off on every drive (10.15)
steps.details: PostInstall disables the Windows Search service (S1). C: `Get-Service WSearch` → `StartType = Disabled`. C† (informational): `Win32_Volume.IndexingEnabled` per fixed volume

steps.title: Display scale 100 % on every output (12.3)
steps.details: PostInstall also writes `Win8DpiScaling = 1`, `LogPixels = 96` (S1; system DPI only [Uncertain] for multi-display). Open `ms-settings:display`. C†: per-monitor DPI = 96 (`GetDpiForMonitor`, app is PerMonitorV2-aware)

steps.title: `ncpa.cpl` → each show adapter: everything except IPv4 unticked; keep Client for MS Networks / File and Printer Sharing for shares (10.10)
steps.details: Open `ncpa.cpl`. C†: `Get-NetAdapterBinding` per physical adapter — list what is still enabled (informational: the checklist allows exceptions)

steps.title: Wake-on-LAN: BIOS + NIC "Wake on Magic Packet" = Enabled (10.11)
steps.details: C†: `Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty` matching "Wake on Magic Packet" (display name is vendor-specific)

steps.title: Services: WinUtil "Set to Manual" covers it; optionally disable Print Spooler, Fax, Bluetooth; never any WATCHOUT/Dataton service
steps.details: Open `services.msc`. Not automated for WO7.

steps.title: No auto-start task (WATCHOUT 7 runs as services; 13.1 not needed)
Windows Security → Manage settings → Tamper Protection Off
steps.details: Open Windows Security (`windowsdefender://threatsettings` [Uncertain URI on 25H2]). C: `Get-MpComputerStatus | Select IsTamperProtected` → `False`. Required only for `-DefenderMode Off`.

steps.title: Options (checklist option table)
steps.details: Options page (MILESTONES M4): `-Role`, `-DefenderMode`, `-KeepFirewall`, `-PinVersion`, `-KeepUpdateService`, `-WatchoutPath`, `-WorkingDirectory`. Shows the exact command line.

steps.title: Elevated, from the show account: `.\WO7-Setup.ps1 -Phase PostInstall`
steps.details: Engine: WO7-Setup.ps1 -Phase PostInstall + options. Pre-checks: show account = elevated user; Tamper Protection (if Off mode); LGPO.exe. Confirmation summary (ARCHITECTURE §4.5).

steps.title: Read the warnings summary; fix and re-run if needed (safe to repeat)
steps.details: Parsed `[WARN]` lines vs "Completed with N warning(s)". Re-run = same step, same options (banner if options changed: earlier changes are not undone).

steps.title: Reboot
Defender
steps.details: `Get-MpComputerStatus | Select IsTamperProtected, RealTimeProtectionEnabled, BehaviorMonitorEnabled, OnAccessProtectionEnabled` → all False (Off mode). Exclusions mode: real-time stays on → expectation shown as "Exclusions present": `Get-MpPreference | Select ExclusionPath, ExclusionProcess`. Skip mode: NotApplicable.

steps.details: `reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile" /v SystemResponsiveness`
